scope: Current build: full unit/provider suites, new atomic first title row/repetition and manual dialog/selection scenarios with actual continuation SVG label counts, table pagination/conversion/presets/fill/transpose, selected-object dispatch, next-style Enter, style rename/creation/reorder/delete/story and related outline/list/bullet/tab/decoration regressions only. This is NOT the cumulative 77-profile full editor sweep.
limitations: Known retained renderer observation: a long row-policy fixture continues a partial body cell below the repeated title on the next page. Text/title counts preserved; exact row-boundary/Hancom layout comparison remains pending.

Only first-row whole-cell title assignment/clear plus repeatHeader and explicit pagination policy in one transaction. Repeat requires first row, row policy and at least one body row. Partial/multiple/scattered title rows and complex tables protected. Manual dialog shares same domain/adapter with Agent; no macro/autosave. Native Hancom parity NOT_RUN.

Existing root simple table pageBreak policy only: none/cell/row (0/1/2). Cell content/format/geometry, table placement and repeatHeader preserved. Protected/merged/nested/mixed/caption/inline/overlap/field documents and >200 cells unsupported. Pagination command does not edit title-row flags; separate set_table_header supports first row only. No exact Hancom layout guarantee, macro or autosave.

Set one paragraph style next link only; future Enter at ordinary body paragraph end follows it, middle split retains source. Default source, character/locked/noncanonical raw endpoints and field documents protected. No macro/autosave.
Rename one nondefault paragraph style name only; no English/shape/type/language/lock edits through rename. Field documents, character/locked/noncanonical raw HWP definitions protected.

Append one paragraph-style definition referencing exact stored source char/para shapes; self next style, empty English name, Korean language and unlocked. Separate apply; no custom shapes, inheritance, delete or macro.

Ordinary body stored section outline levels 0..6/relevel/clear; distinct-target outline-only batch, one request undo. No definition creation/change or builtin fallback; divergent direct references remain protected.
Extended/noncanonical raw resource cloning remains protected; new default resources can be added without reducing original blank HWP definitions.
Explicit stored paragraph restart remains unserialized and strict save/recovery remains blocked on truthful content loss.
No arbitrary new numbering format, section outline shape changes, outline TOC, image/check list, macro or automatic save.
Native Hancom comparison and paid LLM calls NOT_RUN. Native Rust unit tests NOT_RUN; existing 570603 engine reused unchanged with read-only style metadata getter and actual WASM scenarios rerun.
Full documented implementation scope incomplete; no percentage inferred.
